<title>[[*longtitle:notempty=`[[*longtitle]]`:default=`[[*pagetitle]]`]] - Кадровое агентство СПУТНИК-Персонал</title>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="keywords" content="подбор персонала, кадровое агентство, рекрутмент, executive search, хедхантинг, аутстаффинг, домашний персонал, Зеленоград, Москва, Московская область">
<meta name="description" content="СПУТНИК-Персонал — кадровое агентство для работодателей. Подбор персонала в Москве, Зеленограде, Московской области и регионах. Заявка и консультация онлайн.">
<link rel="shortcut icon" href="/images/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Roboto:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="/templates/jd_consult/css/font-awesome.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="/templates/jd_consult/css/cookie-consent.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="/templates/jd_consult/css/theme-modern.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="/templates/jd_consult/css/responsive.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
(function () {
  if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
  var KEY = 'tz-brand-spin-start';
  var PERIOD = 8000;
  var start;
  try {
    var stored = sessionStorage.getItem(KEY);
    start = stored ? parseInt(stored, 10) : Date.now();
    if (!stored) sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, String(start));
  } catch (e) {
    start = Date.now();
  }

  function tick() {
    var angle = ((Date.now() - start) % PERIOD) / PERIOD * 360;
    var rings = document.querySelectorAll('.tz-brand__ring');
    for (var i = 0; i < rings.length; i++) {
      rings[i].style.transform = 'rotate(' + angle + 'deg)';
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>
<script src="/media/jui/js/jquery.min.js" defer></script>
<script src="/templates/jd_consult/js/cookie-consent.js" defer></script>
<script src="/templates/jd_consult/js/theme-animations.js" defer></script>
<script charset="UTF-8" src="//web.webpushs.com/js/push/7d165352ce369b26c03d174e13d0b11a_1.js" async></script>
